inputs.text: Activists in Uttar Pradesh are concerned that, three months after a mandate was issued, the government still hasn't set up a clear process for brick kiln operators to get the required environmental clearance. This has caused ongoing confusion and brought criticism from legal experts and industry stakeholders. Even though they already have approvals from the State Pollution Control Board to follow air and water quality standards, brick kiln owners are willing to get the extra clearances if the process is streamlined and free from middlemen interference, which has been a problem in the past. At the same time, legal professionals are stressing that recent court decisions must be followed, and they are urging the state to fix its oversight and put a proper environmental approval framework in place. Resolving this is crucial for both the environment and the industry.
